'''Deral Reiko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reussi]] who worked as an informant.

==History==
Deral Reiko grew up in [[Torel Vorne]]'s criminal organization where he evolved into an efficient asset locator, and developed his own information agency. In this capacity, he supplied [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] with information of newly-posted bounties.
